[[File:F-4653-a5f1537f81-1-.jpg|thumb|The player's Mobile Command (left) and the opponent's Mobile Command (right; destroyed) as seen from a battle.]]
The Mobile Command (or Command Pod) is the large command vehicle seen in the [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Squad_Bay Squad Bay] and in battles. Destroying the opponent's Mobile Command first automatically grants you victory.

The base health of the Mobile Base can be increased by upgrading it in the [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Research_Lab Research Lab]. It can also be increased by joining a Guild. The amount of base health increased depends on how many active members there are in a Guild.

The Mobile Command base can only be damaged by units placed on an undefended lane. Special attacks (such as Strike, Incendiary, etc.) do not affect the Mobile Command, however.

Players can attach certain [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Equipment Equipment] to the Mobile Command.
